mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.15%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases discount rates for equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 0.15%, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals an imminent economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST < 1100 and UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 240), persistent elevated inflation erodes corporate profit margins and forces central banks to tighten policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS has increased over the prior 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 105.5, it signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO > 105.5, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.1) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 240) indicates a stagflationary environment where monetary policy is ineffective, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in both growth and inflation risks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.1 and CPIAUCSL > 240, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO < 100), declining industrial output signals weakening economic activity that reduces corporate investment and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
